description: 1 master suite (en-suite bathroom with bathtub, walk-in wardrobe), 2 single bedrooms, 1 shared bathroom, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment, windows on right and bottom facades. All three bedrooms face the full-height right facade. Living area faces the bottom facade. Kitchen island present, hob on island facing dining table and living area. Wall countertop runs along the full width of the room allowing for abundant full-height cabinet storage and large appliances. Cook at island directly faces the dining and seating area, suited to cooking while entertaining or supervising children. Living arrangement: linear, kitchen island and wall counter on left, dining center, seating on right. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. TV visible in living area facing seating; cook cannot see TV from island; diners face TV. En-suite bathroom (9.8sqm) with bathtub accessible only from master bedroom (27sqm). Walk-in wardrobe in master bedroom, open wardrobe area with two facing storage units, no closing door. Shared bathroom (5.7sqm) from corridor. Both single bedrooms (15.2sqm and 14.7sqm) have desk visible. Each large enough for bunk bed. Possible configurations, mutually exclusive: (1) two children's bedrooms; (2) one children's bedroom and one home office; (3) two home offices; (4) one or both as guest rooms; (5) bunk bed arrangement. Cannot simultaneously provide two children's bedrooms and a home office without bunk bed. Storage room near entry, suitable for coats, shoes, bikes or utility storage. Entry area provides space for coat and shoe storage. No door between entry and kitchen, relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite at far end from living area, maximum acoustic separation. Suits families with one or two children, couples working from home, households prioritising communal cooking and dining.
not_suitable_for: two children's bedrooms and home office simultaneously without bunk bed
jurisdictions requiring door separation between entry and kitchen
